meta.title: Order Cancellation & Query Operations
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement order cancellation and query operations for order management on Lighter.xyz.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Order cancellation works: cancel transaction signed and submitted, order cancelled
Order history queryable via GET /accountInactiveOrders with fill details
Order status mapping implemented: Lighter status → rustybt OrderStatus enum

key-tasks.task: Implement get_order_history() async method with pagination
Implement status mapping (pending, open, filled, cancelled, partial)

architecture-context.constraint: Rate limiting applied to all API calls

technical-specifications.spec: async def cancel_order(self, broker_order_id: str) -> None: await self._check_request_rate_limit() cancel_tx = self._create_cancel_order_tx(broker_order_id) signed_tx = self._sign_transaction(cancel_tx) response = await self._client.post("/sendTx", json=signed_tx) response.raise_for_status() logger.info("order_cancelled", order_id=broker_order_id)

async def get_open_orders(self) -> list[dict]: response = await self._client.get("/accountActiveOrders", params={"account": self._wallet_address}) return [ { "order_id": order["id"], "symbol": order["symbol"], "side": order["side"], "type": order["order_type"], "quantity": Decimal(str(order["quantity"])), "price": Decimal(str(order["price"])) if order.get("price") else None, "status": self._map_status(order["status"]), } for order in data.get("orders", []) ]
LIGHTER_STATUS_MAP = { "pending": OrderStatus.PENDING, "open": OrderStatus.SUBMITTED, "filled": OrderStatus.FILLED, "cancelled": OrderStatus.CANCELLED, "partially_filled": OrderStatus.PARTIAL_FILL, }
